papers.title: Optimization for Gaussian Processes via Chaining
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of stochastic optimization under a bandit feedback model. We generalize the GP-UCB algorithm [Srinivas and al., 2012] to arbitrary kernels and search spaces. To do so, we use a notion of localized chaining to control the supremum of a Gaussian process, and provide a novel optimization scheme based on the computation of covering numbers. The theoretical bounds we obtain on the cumulative regret are more generic and present the same convergence rates as the GP-UCB algorithm. Finally, the algorithm is shown to be empirically more efficient than its natural competitors on simple and complex input spaces.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于高斯过程优化理论，未涉及FEA代理模型或生物力学设计，因此与研究方向的直接相关性较低。
llm.why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modelling, no handling of constraints, no uncertainty quantification beyond regret bounds, and no transfer to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展GP-UCB算法至任意核和搜索空间
summary_zh.method: 利用局部链式方法控制高斯过程上确界，并基于覆盖数计算优化方案
summary_zh.result: 理论累积遗憾界具有通用性，且收敛速率与GP-UCB相同
summary_zh.validation: 在简单和复杂输入空间上进行了经验比较

summary_en.motivation: To generalize the GP-UCB algorithm to arbitrary kernels and search spaces in stochastic bandit optimization.
summary_en.method: A localized chaining concept is used to control the supremum of a Gaussian process, with a novel optimization scheme based on covering number computation.
summary_en.result: Theoretical cumulative regret bounds are more generic and achieve the same convergence rates as GP-UCB.
summary_en.validation: Empirical comparisons on simple and complex input spaces demonstrate efficiency.

papers.title: Investigations on the microstructure and crack formation of IN738LC samples processed by selective laser melting using Gaussian and doughnut profiles
papers.first_author_affiliation: Inspire AG, ETH Zurich, Lerchenfeldstrasse 5, 9014 St. Gallen, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Michael Cloots
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Inspire AG, ETH Zurich, Lerchenfeldstrasse 5, 9014 St. Gallen, Switzerland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及IN738LC高温合金的SLM加工，与生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, porous structures, fatigue, or osseointegration; it focuses on superalloy processing for non-biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光模式对IN738LC高温合金SLM成形中裂纹形成的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用高斯和环形激光束进行SLM实验，分析微观组织和裂纹。
summary_zh.result: 环形激光束可减少裂纹但改变显微组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和EDS对微观组织进行表征。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser beam profiles on microstructure and crack formation in IN738LC superalloy during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting experiments were conducted using Gaussian and doughnut-shaped laser beams, followed by microstructural analysis via SEM and EDS.
summary_en.result: The doughnut profile reduced crack density but altered the microstructure compared to the Gaussian profile.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization was performed using scanning electron microscopy and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy.

papers.title: Rapid prototyping in the intervertebral implant design process
papers.abstract: Purpose – The purpose of this paper is to present the methodology of a design process of new lumbar intervertebral disc implants with specific emphasis on the use of rapid prototyping technologies. The verification of functionality of artificial intervertebral discs is also given. The paper describes the attempt and preliminary research to evaluate the properties of the intervertebral disc implant prototypes manufactured with the use of different rapid prototyping technologies, i.e. FDM – fused deposition modelling, 3DP – 3D printing and SLM – selective laser melting. Design/methodology/approach – Based on the computed tomography (CT) scan data, the anatomical parameters of lumbar spine bone tissue were achieved, which were the bases for the design-manufacture process carried out with the use of computer-aided designing/computer-aided engineering/computer-aided manufacturing systems. In the intervertebral disc implant design process, three RP technologies: FDM, 3DP and SLM were used for solving problems related to the reconstruction of geometry and functionality of the disc. Some preliminary tests such as measurement of roughness and structural analyses of material of prototypes made by different prototyping technologies were performed. Findings – This paper allowed the authors to elaborate and patent two new intervertebral disc implants. Because the implant designs are parametrical ones with relation to lumbar bone tissue properties measured on CT scans, they can be also made for individual patients. We also compared some of the properties of intervertebral implants prototypes made with the use of FDM, 3DP and SLM technologies. Originality/value – The paper presents the new intervertebral disc implants and their manufacturing by rapid prototyping. The methodology of designing intervertebral disc implant is shown. Some features of the methodology make it useful for preoperative planning of intervertebral disc surgery, as well.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物医学植入物的增材制造与设计流程，但聚焦于腰椎间盘而非髋关节，未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: No hip implant focus, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and only preliminary roughness/structural characterization without mechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出利用快速成型技术设计腰椎间盘植入物的流程。
summary_zh.method: 基于CT数据设计，采用FDM、3DP、SLM制造原型。
summary_zh.result: 获得两项新型椎间盘植入物专利，可实现个性化定制。
summary_zh.validation: 通过粗糙度测量和结构分析初步评估原型性能。

summary_en.motivation: Present a design methodology for lumbar intervertebral disc implants leveraging rapid prototyping technologies.
summary_en.method: CT-based parametric design and fabrication using FDM, 3DP, and SLM.
summary_en.result: Two novel intervertebral disc implant designs patented, enabling patient-specific customization.
summary_en.validation: Preliminary evaluation via surface roughness measurement and structural analysis of prototypes.
